title: zygogynum longifolium
intro: Zygogynum longifolium, commonly known as the Bois d'arc or the Ironwood tree, is a plant species native to New Caledonia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to support immune function and reduce inflammation, making it beneficial for overall health and well-being. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Zygogynum longifolium include lignans and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
